company.name: Tabib ai
company.shortDescription: AI-powered clinical workflow platform for clinics and telemedicine teams.
company.description:
TabibAI is a B2B SaaS clinical workflow AI platform for clinics and telemedicine teams. The platform combines frontier AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google with a specialized medical knowledge layer covering ICD-10, RxNorm, and SNOMED-CT to streamline patient intake, document review, and physician-ready note drafting.

The platform offers six modules: Intake Copilot, Document Review, Doctor Notes, Team Workspace, Safety Layer, and Cloud Foundation. Each module keeps clinicians in control — TabibAI does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace medical judgment. Every AI output is a draft labeled for clinician review.

Founded in June 2026 and headquartered in Egypt, TabibAI is bootstrapped and revenue-generating, serving clinics across Egypt and the MENA region with plans for global expansion. The platform is HIPAA-aware and GDPR-aligned, with encrypted storage, audit logging, and environment separation built into the architecture.
